description: This file defines a utility enum GenericPasswordKeychainStore for storing, retrieving, and deleting generic password data in the Keychain using Security framework. It encapsulates Keychain interactions for String data specifically, providing a high-level API.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string value from the Keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value into the Keychain for a specified service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the keychain item for the specified service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Retrieves raw data from the Keychain for a specific service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Stores raw data into the Keychain, replacing existing data if present.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base query dictionary for Keychain operations based on service and account.
